Independent open-source project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic.

## Features - Route any supported harness to models from any supported provider. - 12 supported harnesses: [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi), [OpenCode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode), [Cline](https://github.com/cline/cline), [Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent), [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), [Grok Build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build), [Muse Code](https://research.meta.ai/blog/introducing-muse-code-and-muse-spark-1-2/), [Aider](https://aider.chat/), [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/docs/getting-started/), or [VS Code Chat](https://code.visualstudio.com/). - Preserved native streaming, tool use, and interleaved thinking for maximum performance. - For Claude Code, route [Fable](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/fable), [Opus](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/opus), [Sonnet](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/sonnet), and [Haiku](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/haiku) to supported models. - 61 supported providers, including free, paid, subscription, and local providers. - 1.3B+ free tokens per month. - FCC follows provider TOS and removes integrations if they stop being allowed. - Use through the terminal, desktop apps ([Codex App](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app), [Claude Desktop](https://claud
